description: This Java source file defines an interface `NamespaceCommandResponse` with nested static class `JsonFields`, which contains JSON field definitions related to namespace command responses within the Eclipse Ditto project. It serves as a base interface for responses to namespace commands, providing JSON schema details for serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: NamespaceCommandResponse
classes.description: A base interface for response signals to namespace commands, parameterized with the response type, extending CommandResponse and WithNamespace.

classes.name: NamespaceCommandResponse.JsonFields
classes.description: A static nested abstract class containing JSON field definitions for namespace command response JSON representations.

methods.name: JsonFields.NAMESPACE
methods.description: Defines the JSON field for the namespace associated with the command response.

methods.name: JsonFields.RESOURCE_TYPE
methods.description: Defines the JSON field for the resource type checked in the command response.
